cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
The following change in 4.1.37 causes a NPE in `FlowControlHandler`:

https://github.com/netty/netty/commit/2c99fc0f1290c65685c5036fdc9884921823ad7d#diff-bb753cb6291385d58a60bc0f59d5402d

The NPE stack:

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: null
	at io.netty.handler.flow.FlowControlHandler.dequeue(FlowControlHandler.java:193)
	at io.netty.handler.flow.FlowControlHandler.channelRead(FlowControlHandler.java:152)
	at io.netty.channel.AbstractChannelHandlerContext.invokeChannelRead(AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java:374)
	at io.netty.channel.AbstractChannelHandlerContext.invokeChannelRead(AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java:360)
	at io.netty.channel.AbstractChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelRead(AbstractChannelHandlerContext.java:352)
	at io.netty.channel.CombinedChannelDuplexHandler$DelegatingChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelRead(CombinedChannelDuplexHandler.java:438)
	at io.netty.handler.codec.ByteToMessageDecoder.fireChannelRead(ByteToMessageDecoder.java:321)
	at io.netty.handler.codec.ByteToMessageDecoder.channelRead(ByteToMessageDecoder.java:295)

```

### Expected behavior

FlowControlHandler should not fail with a NPE.

### Actual behavior

FlowControlHandler sometimes fails with a NPE

### Steps to reproduce

Hard to come up with a reproducer, but the issue manifests if you upgrade to Netty 4.1.37 in a Micronaut application.

Related discussion can be found at https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/1802

### Netty version

4.1.37

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)

Any

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)

Any

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix NPE caused by re-entrance calls in FlowControlHandler
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix NPE caused by re-entrance calls in FlowControlHandler

Motivation:

2c99fc0f1290c65685c5036fdc9884921823ad7d introduced a change that eagly recycles the queue. Unfortunally it did not correct protect against re-entrance which can cause a NPE.

Modifications:

- Correctly protect against re-entrance by adding null checks
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9319.
